_meta.role: Robotics Autonomy Engineer - Planning and Control

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Designed motion planning and control pipelines from simulation to deployment: built an adaptive lane-following and waypoint-fallback control stack for autonomous driving in CARLA, validated across dynamic multi-agent traffic with zero collisions, and derived forward-kinematic motion planning and trajectory execution for a 6-DoF UR5e via ROS2. Experienced diagnosing and resolving field integration issues end to end, from control-loop tuning and sensor telemetry (ToF, visual servoing) to full robot pick-and-place deployment achieving 100% reliability.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) with SoftmaxFocalLoss + ParsingRelationLoss into an adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.
Validated in Town02 with dense traffic and pedestrians; zero collisions and correct signal compliance across multiple regression laps.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup) for visual servoing control and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping telemetry.
Diagnosed and resolved 11 field integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, control-timing drift); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).

projects.name: ABB RobotStudio Automation Simulation
bullets: Designed and simulated a full ABB RobotStudio workcell for an end-to-end press-to-packing industrial assembly pipeline including CAD-modeled fixtures.
Programmed trajectory/pose logic in RAPID with TCP telemetry and interrupt-driven control; validated full-cycle repeatability.

awards: Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
